# `court_opinions`

One row per official Supreme Court opinion package listed for an October Term. Metadata and the PDF URL come from `supremecourt.gov`; embedded text is extracted with the pinned pypdf adapter. A row is a source document, not a docket. An official package can include the Court opinion and separately authored concurrences or dissents; the ingest preserves that package instead of guessing semantic subdocument boundaries.

- **Parquet file:** `court_opinions.parquet`
- **Queryable via MCP `query_sql`:** Yes

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `opinion_id` | `VARCHAR` | Stable Spicy Regs identifier derived from court, term, release number, and docket number. Primary key. |
| `court_id` | `VARCHAR` | Court identifier; currently always `scotus`. |
| `term_year` | `VARCHAR` | Calendar year in which the October Term began (for example `2022`). |
| `release_number` | `VARCHAR` | Opinion release sequence number on the official term index. |
| `date_decided` | `VARCHAR` | Decision date normalized to ISO 8601. |
| `docket_number` | `VARCHAR` | Supreme Court docket number shown on the official term index. |
| `case_name` | `VARCHAR` | Case caption shown on the official term index. |
| `holding` | `VARCHAR` | Official index-page holding summary from the opinion link title. |
| `author_code` | `VARCHAR` | Justice code published in the official term index. |
| `citation` | `VARCHAR` | United States Reports citation shown on the official index. |
| `opinion_type` | `VARCHAR` | Source package classification; currently `official-opinion-package`. |
| `source_index_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official Supreme Court term-index URL. |
| `source_url` | `VARCHAR` | Official Supreme Court PDF URL. |
| `source_etag` | `VARCHAR` | HTTP ETag returned for the fetched PDF, when supplied. |
| `source_last_modified` | `VARCHAR` | HTTP Last-Modified value returned for the PDF, when supplied. |
| `source_bytes` | `VARCHAR` | Exact fetched PDF byte count, stored as a decimal string. |
| `pdf_sha256` | `VARCHAR` | SHA-256 digest of the exact fetched PDF bytes. |
| `pdf_page_count` | `VARCHAR` | Page count reported by the pinned PDF parser. |
| `text_extraction_status` | `VARCHAR` | Embedded-text extraction result; published rows require `ok`. |
| `text_extraction_method` | `VARCHAR` | Extraction implementation identifier, currently `pypdf-embedded-text`. |
| `text_extraction_version` | `VARCHAR` | Pinned pypdf package version used for extraction. |
| `pdf_text` | `VARCHAR` | Page-ordered embedded text extracted from the official PDF; not OCR. |
